findings.note: Tampa Bay placed Brayden Point (undisclosed) on injured reserve Nov. 10, ruling him out against Buffalo; the page says 20-year-old prospect O'Reilly could make his NHL debut and lists Buffalo at +106, slightly shorter than the offered +110.

Covers trend list says Tampa is 5-0 in its last 5 when the opponent scored 2 goals or fewer in its previous game, which applies because Buffalo did. It also says Buffalo is 5-1 in its last 6 on 2 days' rest. These are trends, not a pick.
